recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group later wants BiologicallyDerivedProduct to carry a distinct lot number, that should be handled as a new BDP modeling decision before adding a BDP lot-number search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-35862 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R5 asking for product resources to be searchable by lot number or serial number when a barcode or identifier is known but the resource type is not.
initial_application: Commit 31564391acbf120de82ad6b2720eb87e3270659a added serial-number search parameters for BiologicallyDerivedProduct, Medication, and NutritionProduct and did related product-code alignment work. Commit 08f4ca1bb8bc36faf757a479c54a52f3c02e0429 added NutritionProduct-lot-number, and commit 7ab5e1f3da672bd2b30b9d167228006851dcde7f corrected the initial NutritionProduct code typo from loy-number to lot-number. Device already had lot-number and serial-number search parameters from earlier Device production identifier work.
additional_context: The OO WGM minutes and the earlier Zulip thread frame the requirement as cross-resource product searching by using common search parameter codes across the relevant resources. Later FHIR-47622 work moved Medication serial-number to Medication.instance.identifier. Later BDP search-parameter review in FHIR-51588/FHIR-53204 kept BiologicallyDerivedProduct-serial-number on BiologicallyDerivedProduct.identifier and did not introduce a BDP lot-number element or parameter.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Device, Medication, NutritionProduct, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct are active resources. Current source has serial-number on all four product resources where serial/instance identifiers exist, lot-number on Device, Medication, and NutritionProduct where lotNumber elements exist, and no BiologicallyDerivedProduct lot-number because BDP has no lotNumber source element.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published Device issue added Device production identifier search parameters, including Device lot-number and serial-number.
Product code search-parameter alignment was partly pre-applied in the same 31564391 commit and already has a reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
Applied Medication decision renamed batch to instance and moved the Medication serial-number search parameter to Medication.instance.identifier.
Applied BDP search-parameter cleanup reviewed the BDP parameter set and kept serial-number over identifier without adding lot-number.
Applied BDP normative prep explicitly listed BiologicallyDerivedProduct-serial-number as active.
Resolved-change-required Pharmacy correction concerns Medication serial-number description wording; current source already maps the parameter to Medication.instance.identifier after FHIR-47622.
